in_marathi.name: Ashvani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashvani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashvani is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ashva', which means horse. This name is often associated with the horse goddess, Eshani, and represents strength, grace, and beauty.
